summary: No neutral wire is needed for the Tapo S210 (UK), a 1-gang, 1-way smart switch that replaces your wall switch. Alexa and Google Assistant voice control both go through a Tapo Hub, which Tapo names as the H100 or H200 and sells separately. Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter aren't mentioned, and the UK pages don't say whether it dims.
caveats: Needs a Tapo H100 or H200 hub, sold separately.
TP-Link's UK pages describe on/off control only, so don't assume it dims.
